guidance.bestFor: The stock pattern: labeled Previous and Next around 3 page links, with page 2 outlined as current

whenNotToUse.when: More pages than fit, with the rest folded behind a trailing ellipsis

guidance.bestFor: Chevron only arrows with aria labels and no Previous or Next text, around 3 numbers with page 2 current

whenNotToUse.when: Paging the rows of a records table that also sorts and selects

guidance.bestFor: Labeled Previous and Next around 3 pages whose idle numbers draw a border on hover, like the outlined current page
agentNotes: The hover border lives in the `className` of each idle `PaginationLink`; repeat it on every page link you generate

guidance.bestFor: Fully round page buttons and pill shaped Previous and Next, with page 2 outlined as current
A 320px row fitting chevrons, pages 1 to 3 and an ellipsis beside a small Go to page number field
agentNotes: The number `Input` keeps `defaultValue` 1 and a fixed `max` of 10 with no handler; set `max` to your page count and jump on Enter
The Go to page text is a plain `span`, not a label, so the `Input` has no accessible name; pass an `aria-label`

whenNotToUse.when: A full width table footer with the jump field at the far edge

guidance.bestFor: A padded Card holding round chevrons, pages 1 to 3, an ellipsis, then 10 to 12, with page 1 filled in primary
agentNotes: The primary fill comes from a `className` keyed on `page` 1, apart from `isActive`; tie both to your current page

whenNotToUse.when: Page links set straight on the page with no card around them

guidance.bestFor: Two text links with straight arrow icons pushed to opposite ends of a narrow row, and no page numbers at all

whenNotToUse.when: A reader who must jump straight to a numbered page

name: c-pagination-8
title: Pagination with page info on center
label: Centered Page Info
description: Pagination with page info on center

guidance.bestFor: Chevron arrows at both ends of a 320px row with a centered Page 1 of 10 count between them

name: c-pagination-9
title: Pagination with page info on left
label: Left Page Info
description: Pagination with page info on left

guidance.bestFor: A Page 1 of 10 count on the left, with labeled Previous and Next grouped together on the right
Labeled arrows around pages 1 to 4 and a trailing ellipsis, with no last page link after it

whenNotToUse.when: A long range that keeps the last pages in view after the ellipsis

guidance.bestFor: One bordered strip of joined square cells split by dividers, with a muted fill on the current page
agentNotes: `isActive` marks `index` 2 of the `Array.from` list as current; compare each index to your page state

name: c-pagination-12
title: Rows per page select with range info and first/prev/next/last icons
label: Rows Per Page
description: Rows per page select with range info and first/prev/next/last icons

guidance.bestFor: A footer with no page numbers: a rows per page select on the left, and a 1-25 of 100 range with 4 jump icons on the right
agentNotes: The 1-25 of 100 text is typed apart from the `NativeSelect` `defaultValue` of 25; compute the range from your page size and total
Rows per page sits in a `span`, so the `NativeSelect` has no accessible name; pass it an `aria-label`

whenNotToUse.when: A footer that also lists numbered page links between the arrows

name: c-pagination-13
title: Pagination with page select dropdown and first/last navigation
label: Page Select
description: Pagination with page select dropdown and first/last navigation

guidance.bestFor: A Page 1 to Page 10 dropdown flanked by first, previous, next and last icon links, with no numbered links
agentNotes: The 10 `NativeSelectOption` rows are typed out and nothing handles a change; map them from your page count and navigate on change
The page `NativeSelect` has no label and its options do not name it; pass an `aria-label` for screen readers

whenNotToUse.when: Hundreds of pages, too many to list in one dropdown

guidance.bestFor: Chevrons and pages 1 to 4 on the left of a full width row, with the page number field at the far right
agentNotes: Nothing reads the go to page `Input`; it holds `defaultValue` 1 under a fixed `max` of 10, so cap it at your page count and navigate on Enter
The `Input` is named by nothing, as Go to page sits in a `span`; add an `aria-label` for screen readers

whenNotToUse.when: A pager held to a narrow width, such as a card or sidebar

name: c-pagination-15
title: Pagination with page info, numbered pages, ellipsis, and per-page select
label: Info & Per-Page
description: Pagination with page info, numbered pages, ellipsis, and per-page select

guidance.bestFor: A 3 part footer: a Page 1 of 10 count, labeled arrows around pages 1 to 4 and a per page select
agentNotes: The per page `NativeSelect` has no default, handler or `aria-label`; bind it to your page size and name it

whenNotToUse.when: A footer with no numbered page links, only a range and jump arrows
